responsibility: Implements frontend support for Arm MVE type registration rather than the MVE operation builtin expander itself. It builds the ABI and ACLE tree types for MVE predicate and vector types, conditionally enables floating-point variants, creates tuple record types used by arm_mve_types.h, and services the special #pragma GCC arm "arm_mve_types.h" hook that injects these types into the C/C++ frontend namespace.
same_name_distinction: Implements MVE type registration and the pragma handler that creates ABI, ACLE, and tuple types in the frontend, whereas arm-mve-builtins.def is only the source list of MVE types and arm-mve-builtins.h only exposes the generated indices and shared tables.
